infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: VEIL uses Face ID to unlock your encrypted messages on this device. Your biometrics never leave the device.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: VEIL uses the microphone only during end-to-end encrypted calls. Audio never leaves your device unencrypted.

plugins.photosPermission: VEIL uses the photo library only to attach images you choose to your encrypted messages. Photos never leave the device unencrypted.

plugins.microphonePermission: VEIL uses the microphone only when you tap the mic to record a voice note. The recording is encrypted on this device before it is sent.

plugins.savePhotosPermission: VEIL saves an image to Photos only when you tap Save to Photos on it. Nothing is saved automatically.
